-   [ ] My field values match your requirements.
-   You can view our patterns here: [metadata.schema.json](https://github.com/LunarClient/ServerMappings/blob/master/metadata.schema.json), or take a look below and complete the field checklist:
    -   [ ] `id`: a lowercase string, which should match the folder name _(ex. `myserver`)_
    -   [ ] `name`: a string _(ex. `MyServerPvP`)_
    -   [ ] `description`: hook between 16 and 80 characters in English _(ex. `Home of Competitive Minecraft PvP`)_
    -   [ ] `addresses`: an array with lowercase strings _(ex. `["my.server", "your-server.com"]`)_
        -   You do not need to specify subdomains, Lunar Client services automatically detect them.
    -   [ ] `primaryAddress`: the primary address that people connect to with (please include the subdomain if required) _(ex. `mc.my.server`)_
    -   [ ] `minecraftVersions`: an array with Minecraft versions as strings _(ex. `["1.18._", "1.19.2"]` - Must be versions or subversions supported by Lunar Client)\*
    -   [ ] `primaryMinecraftVersion`: a Minecraft version as a string _(ex. `1.19.2` - Must be a subversion supported by Lunar Client)_
    -   [ ] `primaryColor`: a hexademical color code that primarily distinguishes the server _(ex. `#00FFFF`)_
    -   [ ] `secondaryColor`: a hexademical color code that accompanies the `primaryColor` of the server _(ex. `#FF0000`)_
    -   [ ] `primaryRegion`: the primary region where your server operates in _(ex. `NA`)_
    -   [ ] `regions`: a list of regions where you have servers located that service your players _(ex. `["NA", "EU", "AS"]`)_
    -   [ ] `gameTypes`: a list of games that describe the content on your server, must be a max of 3 listed _(ez. `["PVP", "UHC", "HCF"]`)_

author: jsenko
body:
- Update the CRD to be more suitable for further features:

  - Give Ingress configuration an entire object, moving `(component).host` to `(component).ingress.host`. This will allow us to add for example `(component).ingress.annotations` or `(component).ingress.ingressClass` fields.
  - Create an object to configure storage `app.storage` and add a field to select which storage type to use `app.storage.type`. Currently, the way that the operator determines what storage type is broken, since it always assumes PostgreSQL if data source is provided, and if not, then tries to configure KafkaSQL. This would prevent us from easily supporting other SQL storage types for example. It also moves all storage configuration to use a single field.
  - Improve the model with better docs and some utility methods.
  - Operator will attempt to update the fields automatically.

  There was a suggestion to use `api` instead of `app` for the Registry backend component configuration field, but at this point its not worth it to make such a change.

- Streamline some example files.

author: adambrgmn
body:
## The issue

With the latest upgrade of this package we discovered some issues with importing the module in our project that uses pure ESM in production. It failed saying `SyntaxError: Named export 'SchemaRegistry' not found.`

After some git bisect I've been able to narrrow it down to an upgrade of Typescript in commit `8f47644`. I _think_ Typescript have updated it's build output in an effort to be more spec compliant. At least this is my guess.

The line that causes the issue is in `src/index.ts`: `export { default as SchemaRegistry, DecodeOptions } from './SchemaRegistry'`. That way of directly exporting the default value seems to not work as intended and node's esm/commonjs interop can't really handle the TS output.

You can validate this by yourself by executing the following in a `.mjs` file in the repo (not on this branch):

```js
// test.mjs
import * as csr from './dist/index.js'
console.log(csr)
```

With the _current_ version you will get a log output similar to the one below:

```sh
[Module: null prototype] {
  COMPATIBILITY: { ... },
  SchemaType: { ... },
  __esModule: true,
  avdlToAVSC: [Function: avdlToAVSC],
  avdlToAVSCAsync: [AsyncFunction: avdlToAVSCAsync],
  readAVSC: [Function: readAVSC],
  readAVSCAsync: [AsyncFunction: readAVSCAsync]
  default: {
    SchemaRegistry: [Getter],
    SchemaType: [Getter],
    COMPATIBILITY: [Getter],
    avdlToAVSC: [Getter],
    avdlToAVSCAsync: [Getter],
    readAVSC: [Getter],
    readAVSCAsync: [Getter]
  },
}
```

As you can see `SchemaRegistry` is only available on the `default` object. This means it can currently only be imported like this:

```js
import csr from '@kafkajs/confluent-schema-registry'
console.log(csr.SchemaRegistry)
```

## The fix

This PR fixes the issue above by _first_ importing the SchemaRegistry class _before_ exporting it. This means nodejs's csj/esm interop will be able to detect the export properly and the module can be imported as before. This fix should not be a breaking change and can be considered a bigfix or patch.

## The future

In the future I think it would be great to either default to pure esm in this module, or do set up some kind of dual export with the help of e.g. [tshy](https://github.com/isaacs/tshy).

Currently there are following issue:
1. Debian package will release new version every 1-2 month, when that happen, the SONiC image will use the latest Debian package, the fips feature will broken.
2. On Debian package website, there is no commit ID for debian package, only an archive file of source code. it's difficult to find out the commit ID by that archive file and update submodule of this repo with commit ID, a mismatch commit ID may cause compatibility issue and security issue. an example is 'libk5crypto3-1.20.1-2+deb12u2', in the git repo, there is no 'debian/krb5-1.20.1-2+deb12u2' tag. there are 2 urgent security patches only exist in the archive file:

author: minwooje
body: # 배경 #57 #84 # 작업 내용 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2b9118d4-96f9-43d2-8828-1e56f0f8dd3d ## 1. PopcornOrangeButton 공통 컴포넌트 구현 회원가입 및 상세 화면, 리뷰 작성 화면에서 사용되는 버튼을 공통 컴포넌트로 구현하였습니다. `UIButton` 타입이기 때문에, 바로 속성 변경이 가능합니다(아래 예시 코드 참고). ```swift final class PopcornOrangeButton: UIButton { init(text: String, isEnabled: Bool) { super.init(frame: .zero) configureInitialSetting(isEnabled: isEnabled) configureButtonUI(text: text) } required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented") } } // MARK: - Configure Initial Setting extension PopcornOrangeButton { private func configureInitialSetting(isEnabled: Bool) { self.isEnabled = isEnabled self.cornerRadius(radius: 10) } private func configureButtonUI(text: String) { var config = UIButton.Configuration.filled() config.baseBackgroundColor = isEnabled == true ? UIColor(resource: .popcornOrange) : UIColor(resource: .popcornGray2) config.attributedTitle = AttributedString( text, attributes: AttributeContainer([ .font: UIFont(name: RobotoFontName.robotoSemiBold, size: 15)!, .foregroundColor: UIColor(.white) ]) ) configuration = config } } ``` - 초기화 - 초기화 시 버튼의 `text`와 `isEnabled` 속성을 설정합니다. 상세화면의 경우 항상 `isEnabled = true`이기 때문에, `false`로 고정하지 않았습니다. - 폰트 크기 고정값 - 버튼안에 들어갈 텍스트가 많지 않고, 수정 사항이 발생하더라도, 폰트를 줄일 정도의 수정은 없을 것이라고 판단하였습니다. - SE 같은 작은 기기에서도 15의 크기가 크다고 느껴지지 않았기 때문에, 고정값으로 설정하였습니다. - 사용 예시 ```swift // 선언부 private let reviewCompleteButton = PopcornOrangeButton(text: "리뷰 등록하기", isEnabled: false) // 버튼 속성 변경 reviewCompleteButton.isEnabled = true reviewCompleteButton.configuration?.baseBackgroundColor = UIColor(resource: .popcornOrange) ``` > `feat: PopcornOrangeButton 공통 컴포넌트 구현` 커밋과 `feat: PopcornOrangeButton의 활성화/비활성화 구현` 커밋에서 나누어 구현하였기 때문에, 구현 코드를 PR에 첨부하였습니다. ## 2. StarRatingView에서 0.5점 이상 지정하도록 변경 ### 변경 사항 리뷰 등록 시 **평점 입력 여부**와 리뷰 내용의 최소 글자 수(10자)에 따라 리뷰 등록 버튼이 활성화되도록 구현하였습니다. ### 배경 팝업 스토어의 평점, 10자 이상의 리뷰를 남겨야 리뷰 등록하기 버튼의 활성화를 하는 로직 구현이 필요하였습니다. 기존 로직에서는 사용자가 0점의 평점을 줄 수 있었기 때문에, 사용자가 실제로 평점을 입력했는지 여부를 판단할 수 없었습니다. ### 해결 방안 - **최소 평점 제한(0.5점 이상)** 을 도입하였습니다. - 배달의 민족, 오늘의 집 등 다른 앱을 참고하였을 때, 최소 평점이 0.5점 이상이었습니다. - Popcorn에서도 최소 평점 제한을 둔다면 리뷰 등록하기 버튼의 활성화 여부를 판단할 수 있을 것이라고 생각하였습니다. (다른 앱에서도 이러한 의도로 최소 평점 제한을 둔지는 모르겠습니다...) - 현재 평점이 0점일 경우, 평점 입력이 되지 않은 상태로 판단하여 리뷰 등록 버튼이 비활성화되도록 설정하였습니다. ### 변경된 코드 ```swift private func convertToStarRating(from location: CGFloat) -> Float { ... var rating: Float if remaining < 0.25 { rating = Float(flooredRating) } else if remaining < 0.75 { rating = Float(flooredRating) + 0.5 } else { rating = Float(flooredRating) + 1.0 } return max(rating, 0.5) } ``` 기존의 로직을 최대한 유지하기 위해 사용자의 입력값과 0.5중 최댓값을 반환하도록 하였습니다. ## 3. 뷰 모델 구현 ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e91e0032-bfe9-4c97-ad95-cb839033ec51) ### 데이터 흐름 `WriteReviewViewModel`은 데이터 흐름 측면에서 다음과 같은 역할을 합니다. - 사용자가 입력한 데이터를 서버로 전송 - 사용자가 등록한 리뷰 이미지를 저장 - 리뷰 이미지를 컬렉션뷰에 표시하기 위해 뷰에 데이터 전달. ### 뷰의 상태 관리 또한 입력된 데이터의 값에 따라 리뷰 등록 버튼의 활성화 여부를 저장할 필요가 있었습니다. 따라서 `rating`, `reviewText` 프로퍼티에 `didSet`에서, **평점 입력 여부**, **10자 이상의 리뷰 등록 여부**를 판단하는 `validateSubmitEnabled()` 메서드를 호출하여 리뷰 등록 버튼을 활성화 시키도록 구현하였습니다. ## 4. PHPicker 구현 `PHPicker`를 통해 리뷰 이미지를 등록하도록 구현하였습니다. ### 동작 - 플레이스 홀더 이미지를 누를 시 `PHPicker`를 생성 후 `present` 합니다. - 사진이 등록된 셀을 누를 시 아래와 같이 이미지를 초기화 할 것인지 여부를 묻는 Alert을 띄웁니다. ### 사진 선택 개수 제한(`PHPickerConfiguration.selectionLimit`) > 기존에 이미지를 6장 선택하였음. > 왼쪽: 이미지를 선택할 수 있는 상태 > 오른쪽: 최대 이미지 등록 개수(6 + 4 = 10)을 초과하여 더 이상 이미지를 선택할 수 없는 상태(사진이 회색으로 표시됨.) `PHPicker` 생성 시 매번 등록된 이미지의 개수를 기준으로 `selectionLimit`을 갱신합니다. - `collectionview`의 `didSelectItemAt` 메서드에서 `PHPicker`를 생성하는 `configurePHPicker`를 호출합니다. - 이때, `viewModel.provideReviewImagesCount()` 메서드를 통해 현재 등록된 이미지의 개수를 받아옵니다. - 사진은 최대 10장까지 등록할 수 있으므로, Picker를 생성하는 메서드 `configurePHPicker`의 파라미터로 `selectionLimit`를 전달합니다. ```swift func collectionView(_ collectionView: UICollectionView, didSelectItemAt indexPath: IndexPath) { let image = viewModel.provideReviewImages(at: indexPath.item) if image != UIImage(resource: .uploadImagePlaceholder) { presentResetAlert(for: indexPath.item) } else { // ⭐️ 추가로 등록할 수 있는 이미지 개수 구하기 let selectionLimit = 10 - viewModel.provideReviewImagesCount() configuerPHPicker(selectionLimit: selectionLimit) } } ``` ```swift private func configuerPHPicker(selectionLimit: Int) { var config = PHPickerConfiguration() // ⭐️ 추가로 등록할 수 있는 이미지 개수 제한하기 config.selectionLimit = selectionLimit config.filter = .images let phPickerViewController = PHPickerViewController(configuration: config) phPickerViewController.delegate = self self.present(phPickerViewController, animated: true) } ``` # 테스트 방법 ## 입력 데이터 테스트 데이터를 모두 입력하고, 리뷰 등록하기 버튼을 누르면 터미널에 입력된 데이터가 출력됩니다. ## PHPicker로 등록한 이미지와 컬렉션 뷰 표시 - 추가한 사진이 컬렉션 뷰에 표시되는지 확인합니다. - 추가한 사진의 삭제가 의도대로 동작하는지 확인합니다. - 사진이 최대 10장까지 등록되는지 확인합니다. # 리뷰 노트 리뷰 이미지 등록 시 얼럿을 통해 사진을 초기화 하는 방법이 어떤지 피드백해주시면 감사하겠습니다!

author: carme-hp
body:
## Main changes of this PR


## Motivation and additional information

This PR adds a compositional coupling test, in particular a test that uses 5 participants. The test is motivated by my muscle-OpenDiHu application case. The config file is ilustrated here:

![5_participants](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fd02c3fa-9b64-4d90-9da8-d127f2fee50f)

I have hidden data access, communicators, mapping and coupling schemes for better visibility. There are 
- 2 serial-explicit schemes (unidirectional)
- 2 serial-explicit schemes (bidirectional)
- 1 multi-coupling scheme (participants M1SM, M2SM and Tendon)

This test is related to https://github.com/precice/precice/issues/1907. When tests were restricted to 4 ranks, I adapted my use-case by removing the tendon: Instead of a multi-coupling scheme connecting M1SM and M2SM through the tendon, I had a parallel-implicit scheme connecting M1SM and M2SM directly. There I observed that I was not able to add the 1 of the 2 serial-explicit schemes (unidirectional) I have in this test, and that the one I could add depended on who was the first participant in the parallel-implicit scheme. 
However adding the second serial-explicit (unidirectional) scheme here did not raise any problem.

author: traversaro
body:
The use of CMake imported targets to link Poco has the following advantages:


* It generated relocatable cmake config files (see https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/manual/cmake-packages.7.html#creating-relocatable-packages)

* It does not raise an error like:

~~~
CMake Error in build/_deps/abb_librws-src/CMakeLists.txt:
  Target "abb_librws" INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES property contains path:

    "C:/Users/gcorrenti/idjl-software/.pixi/envs/idjllancedeformationenv/Library/include"

  which is prefixed in the source directory.
~~~

when the `abb_librws` is installed in a folder that is contained in source folder of the cmake project that is calling `find_package(abb_librws)`, as it commonly happens if Poco is installed in a project-oriented package manager, for example [pixi](https://pixi.sh/latest/) or [vcpkg when used in manifest mode](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/vcpkg/concepts/manifest-mode).

I checked in Ubuntu and Poco imported targets are available in Poco's apt packages at least since Ubuntu 18.04, so I think we should be safe w.r.t. to backward compatibility.

A large merge into dev, the bulk of which is concerned with multiple explanations for images only. In addition to adding this feature, this pull request also 

- fixes database writing for single explanations , multi explanations and spectral explanations
- fixes writing additional data into the `Prediction` object
- makes insertion/deletion curve normalisation an option in `rex.toml` 
- moves spatial explanation extraction to pure torch and away from numpy
- adds a number of extra options into `rex.toml`
- simplifies cmdline args
- introduces `contrastive` explanation type

author: andypf
body:
# Summary

This update introduces a **new Extension Loading Mechanism** powered by npm, ensuring seamless integration of extensions into the application. Extensions are loaded into a temporary folder via npm, moved to `node_modules`, and accompanied by auto-generated import files for both client-side and server-side use—forming the backbone of this system.

Additionally, the server architecture has been streamlined by integrating Vite directly into Fastify using the `@fastify/vite` package. This allows for a single-server setup in development and production, eliminating the need for a standalone Vite server.

---

# Changes Made

### Key Updates
- **Extension Loading Mechanism:**
  - Extensions installed via npm.
  - Files moved to `node_modules` for integration.
  - Auto-generates client and server import files.
- **`@fastify/vite` Integration:**
  - Combined Fastify and Vite into a single-server setup.
  - Simplifies development and production workflows.
- **Configuration Cleanup:**
  - Unified and streamlined configurations for consistency.
---

This update significantly simplifies server management, enhances extensibility with the new extension loading mechanism, and provides a cleaner configuration structure.
